visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female speaker with short dark hair and round glasses is framed in a medium shot, sitting on a beige sofa. She wears a white lace-patterned cardigan over a white collared shirt and brown trousers, using expressive hand gestures while speaking directly to the camera. The background consists of a neutral-toned wall with vertical curtains and soft indoor lighting. (2) The visual sequence cuts between the speaker and close-up clinical photographs of human skin, specifically showing large, dark brown pigmentation patches on a patient's cheeks and nose. The lighting on these still images is bright and even, highlighting the skin texture and discoloration. (3) Large white subtitles and variety-style text overlays appear frequently in the center of the frame to emphasize specific medical ingredients and keywords mentioned by the speaker. The camera remains static throughout the live-action segments, maintaining a professional eye-level perspective. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the correct medical approach to treating melasma (liver spots), emphasizing that controlled inflammation is a necessary part of the skin's structural change during treatment. It uses a anecdotal story about a Thai doctor to introduce professional skincare knowledge and indirectly promote the DRX Series Skincare brand.
